Kliczków Castle is a conference and leisure center, where history meets modernity, tradition with present days, and hospitality and care for guests has become a showcase of this place.
Perfectly connected, situated at the junction of two motorways A4 and A18, and at the same time hidden in the forest, it is a perfect place to relax.
The castle swimming pool in the former riding hall, saunas and the atmospheric Thalgo SPA will provide rest and relaxation and children will have fun in the playroom or on the park playground.
In the Castle you will find 219 beds in stylish castle apartments, romantic chambers, comfortable hotel apartments or family studio rooms.
We have seven conference rooms with modern multimedia / audiovisual equipment, which are excellent facilities for organizers and participants of meetings. We have experience in organizing both small business meetings and conferences with several hundred of people. We make every effort to ensure that the organization of family celebrations weddings, baptisms, communions, birthdays and various types of anniversaries meets the most demanding tastes and expectations of our guests. It is impossible not to mention here about the castle kitchen, which thanks to the combination of culinary traditions with the experience and knowledge of our chefs / our Chef perfectly complements the entire celebration.
Kliczków Castle is located in the heart of Lower Silesian Forests. Both enthusiasts of active rest and those looking for peace and complete relaxation will find their place here. Professional and friendly staff makes every effort to ensure that you can relax and recharge your batteries here.

About us Zamek Kliczków
Skip to content
About us
The Mediaeval KLICZKÓW CASTLE is located among dense Lower Silesian Woods, at the meanders of the Kwisa river.
It is an exceptional place in which history and tradition go hand in hand with modernity and technology, and each moment is magical and unforgettable.
Kliczków Castle is a historical conference and leisure centre located in Lower Silesian Woods, near Bolesławiec at the intersection of A4 and A18 motorways. It is easily reachable but at the same time hidden in the forests. It is a perfect place for active and healthy holidays with the family.
It offers seven different conference rooms and perfectly equipped SPA&Wellness centre with a swimming pool.
HOTEL RULES
RULES OF STAY OF ANIMALS
STANDARDS FOR THE PROTECTION OF MINORS
KLICZKÓW CASTLE OFFERS 219 BEDS IN 88 HIGH STANDARD ROOMS:
59 Standard rooms
9 Family rooms
2 Mini studio apartments
6 Studio rooms
3 Castle chambers
5 Hotel apartments
2 Castle apartments
1 Imperial apartment
1 Generalski apartment
There is a place in Lower Silesia that seduces visitors with a mystery of Mediaeval history, attracts with neo-renaissance beauty of architecture and excellent feeling for the needs of a modern client.
Far from the hustle and bustle of the city, cuddled in the scenery of Lower Silesian Woods, at the Kwisa river, the majestic Kliczków Castle is located. The biggest such conference and hotel facility in Poland, restored to its former glory by Integer, smoothly combines respect for history with a rich hotel and conference offer.
Cuisine based on local products, fascinating legends, abundant greenery and neighbourhood of wild nature. State-of-the-art conference rooms, rich SPA offer, quests, local festivities, knight performances. The soul of Kliczków Castle opens its arms to you, your families and friends!
